title: Welcome to Software Engineering
content: Welcome to Level 1! In this chapter, you learn how computers execute software instructions. Your first mission is to understand memory, execution stack, and basic console printing.
initialCode:
// Chapter 1: Print Hello Software World
console.log("Hello, Software Engineer!");

title: Understanding Variables & Memory
content: Variables act as labeled storage containers in system RAM. Learn how to declare immutable (const) and mutable (let) variables.

title: Data Types & Operators
content: Learn primitives: String, Number, Boolean, BigInt, and Symbol. Perform basic arithmetic and comparison logic.

title: Conditional Logic & Control Flow
content: Control system behavior using if-else statements and switch blocks based on runtime conditions.

title: Loops and Iteration Engine
content: Automate repetitive algorithms efficiently using for, while, and do-while loops.
